help.development: Local development: synthetic data, no customers affected.
help.test: Test environment: synthetic data, no customers affected.
help.staging: Staging: pre-production data, no customers affected.
help.production: Production: every action here affects live customers and is audited.

noRole.title: No platform access
noRole.text: Your account has no platform role. Track Operations is reserved for Track’s own operators; a platform admin grants roles with the ops:grant command, and every grant is audited.

twoFactor.title: Enable two-factor authentication first
twoFactor.text: Track Operations requires two-factor authentication for every operator (step-up). Enable it for your account, sign in again and come back to this page.

insufficientRole.title: Platform admin required
insufficientRole.text: This area is limited to platform admins. Platform support sees organisations, break-glass, platform health, inbox, growth, audit and content.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist in Track Operations or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The error has been recorded. Try again or go back to the overview.

placeholder.title: In preparation
placeholder.text: This module is being built. Nothing here is measured yet, so no numbers are shown.

rules.noRawData: No raw event payloads, end-user personal data or secrets — aggregated and metadata views only.
rules.breakGlass: Tenant details need an approved, time-boxed break-glass grant; even then read-only, and every view is audited with the grant id.
rules.audit: Every change is a server action with role check, validation, explicit confirmation and an audit entry with actor kind “platform”.

overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: Platform-wide status at a glance: what needs attention, which modules exist and the rules every operator works under.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.intro: Every customer organisation with plan, sites, usage and health — metadata and aggregates, never their event data.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass
breakGlass.intro: Time-boxed, justified and approved access to one organisation’s details: requests, approvals, active grants and their audit trail.

health.title: Platform health
health.intro: Worker heartbeats, queues, delivery success, dead letters and vendor status across all tenants.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.intro: Subscriptions, monthly recurring revenue, trials, overages and failed payments from the billing ledger and Stripe.

controls.title: Controls
controls.intro: Global and per-tenant kill switches, suspensions and feature flags — every switch confirmed and audited.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.intro: Contact, demo and support requests from the public forms with status, assignee and handling time.

growth.title: Growth
growth.intro: Sign-ups, activation, published configurations and conversion to paid plans — aggregated, no individual visitors.

audit.title: Audit
audit.intro: The platform audit log: every operator action with actor, target, organisation and redacted diff.

users.title: Platform users
users.intro: Operators with a platform role, their two-factor state and the four-eyes rule for granting roles.

content.title: Content
content.intro: Tracking Knowledge editorial board: status and review age per locale from the front matter, reader feedback, learning paths, sitemap and feed freshness, integration coverage. Read-only — the content lives in git.
